timestamp_precision: Minute-level research-run observation; individual provider event/capture timestamps are retained separately.

source_capture_policy.admission_rule: Keep all observations outside the feature store until exact provider payloads are captured with SHA-256 receipts, source event timestamps, venue coverage and independent clock anchoring.

source_registry.raw_capture_status: rendered page only; event timestamp absent
rendered page and JSON metadata only

source_registry.fund_universe: five spot ETFs; exact fund list not fully exposed in rendered summary

swiftedge.caveat: Single-provider composite. No raw trade tape, venue list, synchronized venue timestamps or immutable payload receipt captured.

venue_limitations: Binance and Bitget are excluded even though Binance is a major XRP spot venue.
Full-depth coverage comes from Coinbase, Bitstamp, Bitfinex and Gemini; OKX and Kraken add near-price depth only.
Hourly columns average one-minute snapshots, so short-lived walls are diluted.
Resting orders can be cancelled; displayed depth is not a committed fill.

comparison.rule: Do not average provider values. Record contract, venue, source timestamp and capture timestamp independently.

interpretation: Positive funding means longs pay shorts; +0.0100% per eight hours is approximately 10.95% simple annualized carry before fees and compounding.
Open interest is outstanding contract notional, not spot capital inflow or proof of XRP purchases.
Positive funding and rising OI can reflect directional demand, hedging or crowded leverage; they do not determine direction.
The seven-contract aggregate includes both USDT and USDC contracts and is not a seven-exchange measure.

xrp_insights.xrpr: included, with indirect ETP exposure caveat

cryptokeyhole.nov4_status: partial; not a complete daily total

interpretation: The trackers use different fund universes, issuer publication times and flow rules. Their partial daily totals cannot be combined or averaged.
XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole derive flows from issuer holdings changes and share the same issuer-source family; they are not independent primary cash-flow sources.
CryptoETF.today's zero flow refers only to its two reporting funds on the partial 4 November snapshot, not the complete five-fund universe.
The XRP Insights -194,875 XRP two-day total and CryptoKeyhole -6,678 XRP two-day total describe different universes; the 188,197 XRP difference remains unattributed.
Holdings changes can include fees, index rebalancing and indirect ETP exposure. They are not equivalent to verified USD creations/redemptions.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Bid-side displayed depth is thicker near the current price and may provide temporary liquidity support.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Fuelmaps excludes Binance/Bitget, averages minute snapshots, and resting orders can be cancelled; Swiftedge is a single-provider composite.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive funding and rising open interest may indicate leveraged long demand.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Funding is at a common +0.0100% level across several contracts, OI is not spot capital, and hedging can create the same observation.

competing_hypotheses.claim: ETF holdings may be changing across the broader fund universe.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Three aggregators report different partial fund universes; no issuer-level cash creation/redemption records or byte-complete receipts were captured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Price near the 24-hour volume point of control may indicate local balance.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Swiftedge is one provider and its snapshot is not synchronized to Fuelmaps or exchange-native feeds.

predictive_admission.feature_policy: Keep per-venue order-book depth, funding, OI by contract, ETF fund-level holdings and source completeness as separate features. Never collapse them into one bullish/bearish score.
quality_gates: Exact raw payload bytes and SHA-256 receipts for each source.
Venue and contract identity with synchronized event and capture timestamps.
Book-depth venue coverage and snapshot averaging method.
ETF fund-universe and issuer publication-time masks.
No directional inference from resting orders, funding or OI alone.
